sentences.text: Mortenson’s reports score higher than SmithGroup’s.
Across all their report types, Mortenson’s reports score a typical 1.8 points higher than SmithGroup’s (95% interval 1.3 to 2.3; 135 and 33 reports).
Mortenson publishes more industry or market reports, which score higher across The List.
Comparing like with like, the gap reverses, to 0.4 points lower (−0.4 to 1.5) and can’t be told apart from chance.
For every 100 claims, Mortenson’s reports have 5.5 that claim more cause than the study shows and SmithGroup’s have 9.7 (SmithGroup’s 1.8 times as many; 1.3 to 2.5).
Since 2016, Mortenson’s scores have fallen by about 0.5 points a year (0.2 to 0.6).
Since 2016, the share of Mortenson’s claims that cite nothing has risen by about 5.2 per 100 claims a year (3.0 to 7.4).
Mortenson’s and SmithGroup’s trends in the share of claims that claim more cause than the study shows differ by about 1.5 per 100 claims a year (0.8 to 2.4).
